# POINT · FACE — Expert Facials in Uluwatu, Bali

> POINT · FACE is an expert facial studio in Uluwatu, Bali, with two studios in Ungasan and Bingin. Korean Hydrafacials, HydroJelly facials, Balinese natural facials and face-sculpting massages (Kobido, Buccal, Gua Sha). Every treatment starts with a free skin analysis using AI-powered diagnostic technology. Rated 4.9/5 on Fresha, with more than 2,000 clients welcomed.

Key facts:
- Two studios in Uluwatu, Bali: POINT · FACE Uluwatu Ungasan (Jl. Toya Ning II No. 99, Ungasan, Kuta Selatan, Bali 80361); POINT · FACE Uluwatu Bingin (Bingin Downtown Avenue, Jl. Pantai Cemongkak No. 9, Pecatu, Kuta Selatan, Bali 80361).
- Hours: Uluwatu Ungasan: Mon–Sat · 10:00 – 19:00 · Sun · 12:00 – 19:00; Uluwatu Bingin: Every day · 10:00 – 19:00.
- Booking: WhatsApp (Uluwatu Ungasan: +628133793880, Uluwatu Bingin: +6282339078379) or online on Fresha.
- Every treatment includes a free skin analysis using AI-powered diagnostic technology.
- HydroJelly Hydrafacials are exclusive to Uluwatu Ungasan; Korean Body Hydrafacials (back, chest, booty) are exclusive to Uluwatu Bingin.
- 3-session packages: −30% on Korean, HydroJelly and Body Hydrafacials, −20% on natural facials and face massages, valid 5 months (see https://www.pointfacebali.com/packages/).
- 4.9/5 average rating on Fresha; more than 2,000 clients welcomed.
- All prices include 15% government tax & service charge. No additional fees.
- Skincare brands: COSRX, SKIN1004, Beauty of Joseon, Mediheal, Medicube, Utama Spice, Embun.
- Technologies: hydrodermabrasion (Hydrafacial), ultrasonic infusion, oxygen therapy, radiofrequency, microcurrent, high frequency, cold hammer, cryo globes, 7-colour LED.
- Specialities: Korean glass-skin facials, Korean Hydrafacials, HydroJelly masks, PDRN (salmon DNA) repair facial, acne facials, anti-aging & lifting facials, after-sun / post-surf facials, Balinese natural facials, Kobido, Buccal (intra-oral) and Gua Sha face massage.
- Instagram: @pointfacebali

## Treatments

### Korean Advanced Hydrafacials
- [Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift](https://www.pointfacebali.com/treatments/ultimate-korean-glass-skin-hydralift/): 80 min, IDR 1,300,000. Our signature Korean Hydrafacial: 18+ advanced steps to deeply cleanse, hydrate, lift and refine the skin for a true glass-skin finish. Recommended for: Dull, dehydrated or tired skin needing instant radiance.
- [Advanced Collagen Booster](https://www.pointfacebali.com/treatments/advanced-collagen-booster/): 70 min, IDR 1,250,000. A collagen-stimulating Korean Hydrafacial combining peptide infusion, radiofrequency lifting and microcurrent sculpting. Recommended for: Anyone looking to boost firmness and elasticity and keep a plump complexion.
- [PDRN Cellular Repair (Salmon DNA)](https://www.pointfacebali.com/treatments/pdrn-cellular-repair-salmon-dna/): 60 min, IDR 1,300,000. An advanced regenerative Korean Hydrafacial powered by PDRN (salmon DNA) to repair the skin barrier and accelerate recovery. Recommended for: Sensitive, dehydrated or stressed skin; skin recovering from sun, travel or breakouts.
- [K-Balance Acne Clear](https://www.pointfacebali.com/treatments/k-balance-acne-clear/): 70 min, IDR 1,200,000. A targeted Korean Hydrafacial with tea tree, niacinamide and BHA to deep-clean pores, regulate sebum and calm inflammation. Recommended for: Oily, acne-prone or congested skin; blackheads and active breakouts.
- [Vitamin C Sunshine Glow](https://www.pointfacebali.com/treatments/vitamin-c-sunshine-glow/): 60 min, IDR 1,150,000. A radiance-boosting Korean Hydrafacial powered by Vitamin C and advanced Korean brightening skincare for a brighter, smoother, more luminous complexion. Recommended for: Dull skin, uneven skin tone, pigmentation concerns and lack of radiance.

### Face Massages
- [Kobido Massage — Collagen Cream](https://www.pointfacebali.com/treatments/kobido-massage/): 30 min IDR 500,000 / 60 min IDR 850,000. The Japanese facelift massage: deep lifting motions, lymphatic drainage and precise tapping with our collagen cream. Recommended for: Puffiness, loss of firmness, tired features — anyone wanting a natural lift.
- [Buccal Massage](https://www.pointfacebali.com/treatments/buccal-massage/): 15 min, IDR 250,000. A deep intra-oral facial massage: we work the jaw and cheek muscles from inside the mouth to release tension and redefine contours. Recommended for: Jaw clenching, facial tension, puffiness, lack of definition.
- [Gua Sha Massage](https://www.pointfacebali.com/treatments/gua-sha-massage/): 30 min, IDR 350,000. A relaxing facial massage with centella oil and traditional Gua Sha tools to release tension and improve circulation. Recommended for: Stress, facial tension, mild puffiness — a relaxing reset.
- [Relaxation Ritual](https://www.pointfacebali.com/treatments/point-face-relaxation-ritual/): 45 min, IDR 550,000. A deeply relaxing ritual: face, head and arm massage, with LED therapy and a nourishing mask. Recommended for: Anyone needing deep relaxation — jet lag, stress, a slow afternoon.

- LED Therapy — 7 colours: IDR 100,000. Blue purifies, green calms, yellow brightens, red boosts collagen, cyan refines, orange revitalises and violet regenerates.
- Collagen Eye Patch: IDR 100,000. Cooling hydrogel patches with peptides and collagen to de-puff and hydrate the eye area.
- Lip Scrub: IDR 85,000. A creamy Korean lip scrub that buffs away dry, flaky skin while your mask develops.

## Which facial should I book?
- Instant glow, hydration, glass skin: Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift (signature).
- Fine lines, firmness: Advanced Collagen Booster or Caviar Luxury Anti-Aging & Lift.
- Acne, congestion: K-Balance Acne Clear.
- Sunburn, after surf, sensitive skin: Cryo Skin Reset or PDRN Cellular Repair.
- Pigmentation, dark spots: Bright & Pigment Correct.
- Dry or sensitive skin, natural products: Hydrating Ritual (Rose & Aloe).
- Jaw tension, puffiness, contour: Buccal Massage, Kobido.

## Studios
- [POINT · FACE Uluwatu Ungasan](https://www.pointfacebali.com/locations/uluwatu-ungasan/): Our first studio, on Jl. Toya Ning in Ungasan — ten minutes from Melasti, Pandawa and the Uluwatu clifftop villas. Calm treatment rooms, Hydrafacial technology and a complimentary skin analysis before every facial.
- [POINT · FACE Uluwatu Bingin](https://www.pointfacebali.com/locations/uluwatu-bingin/): Our Bingin studio sits in the heart of the surf village, a few minutes from Bingin, Dreamland, Padang Padang and Uluwatu beaches — made for post-surf skin repair, sun recovery and a glow before sunset.

## Skin concerns
- [Anti-Aging & Firming Facials in Uluwatu, Bali: Fine Lines, Wrinkles & Sagging](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/fine-lines-wrinkles-bali/): Prevent the signs of aging, boost collagen and keep the skin from sagging, without needles. Our anti-aging facials combine Korean peptides, radiofrequency, microcurrent and red LED to firm the skin and soften the look of lines.
- [Acne, Breakouts & Blackheads Facials in Uluwatu, Bali](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/acne-breakouts-bali/): Humidity, sweat, sunscreen and salt water — Bali is tough on congested skin. Our acne facials deep-clean pores, clear blackheads, rebalance oil and calm inflammation without stripping your skin.
- [Dehydrated Skin Facials in Uluwatu, Bali](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/dehydrated-skin-bali/): Tight, dull, flaky — yet still oily? That is dehydration, the most common skin concern we see in Uluwatu. Our hydrating facials flood the skin with water and repair the barrier that keeps it in.
- [After-Sun & Post-Surf Facials in Uluwatu, Bali](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/sun-damaged-skin-bali/): Surf sessions at Bingin, afternoons at Padang Padang, sunsets on the cliffs. Our after-sun facials cool, calm and repair skin that has seen a lot of sun.
- [Pigmentation & Dark Spot Facials in Uluwatu, Bali](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/pigmentation-dark-spots-bali/): Sun spots, post-acne marks, an uneven tone. Our Korean brightening protocol targets pigmentation with vitamin C and niacinamide — and helps you protect your results in the Bali sun.
- [Glass Skin Facial in Uluwatu, Bali — For Dull, Tired Skin](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/dull-tired-skin-glass-skin/): Glass skin is the Korean ideal of skin so smooth, hydrated and clear it reflects light like glass. It is not about make-up — it is about hydration, texture and a healthy barrier.
- [Facials for Sensitive & Reactive Skin in Uluwatu, Bali](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/sensitive-reactive-skin/): Redness, stinging, heat, reactions to new products. Sensitive skin needs facials that calm and repair — never strip.
- [Face Sculpting Massage in Uluwatu — Puffiness & Jaw Tension](https://www.pointfacebali.com/concerns/puffiness-jaw-tension/): A clenched jaw, a puffy morning face, features that look tired. Our sculpting massages work the muscles and lymph for a defined, relaxed face — naturally.

## Journal
- [Best Hydrafacial in Bali: What Makes a Great Hydrafacial (and Where to Book in Uluwatu)](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/best-hydrafacial-bali/): The best Hydrafacial in Bali starts with a real skin analysis, uses a multi-function Hydrafacial system (hydrodermabrasion, extraction, ultrasonic and oxygen infusion, radiofrequency, LED), infuses actives chosen for your concern, and ends with aftercare adapted to sun and sea. In Uluwatu, POINT · FACE offers five Korean Hydrafacials at both studios, three HydroJelly Hydrafacials in Ungasan and Korean Body Hydrafacials in Bingin.
- [Best Things to Do in Uluwatu & Bali (and Where to Get a Facial)](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/things-to-do-uluwatu-bali/): In Uluwatu, watch the sunset and Kecak fire dance at Uluwatu Temple, spend your days on the beaches of Bingin, Padang Padang, Dreamland, Suluban and Melasti, surf or watch the surfers, and have a seafood dinner on Jimbaran Bay. From the Bukit, day trips reach Ubud, Nusa Dua and the islands. Between beach days, book a facial at POINT · FACE in Ungasan or Bingin to repair sun-exposed skin.
- [Korean Skincare Ingredients: Benefits of Snail Mucin, Centella, PDRN & More](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/korean-skincare-ingredients-benefits/): Korean skincare is built on gentle, hydrating, barrier-friendly actives. Snail mucin and hyaluronic acid hydrate and plump, centella asiatica calms and repairs, niacinamide evens tone and regulates oil, peptides and PDRN support firmness and recovery, BHA clears pores, and vitamin C brightens. At POINT · FACE we infuse them with Hydrafacial technology, using COSRX, SKIN1004, Mediheal, Medicube and Beauty of Joseon.
- [Post-Surf Skin Care in Uluwatu: Protect & Repair Your Skin](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/post-surf-skin-care-uluwatu/): Surfers' skin takes a triple hit in Uluwatu: intense equatorial UV amplified by reflection off the water, salt that dries the surface and wind that strips moisture. Protect it with a water-resistant SPF 50 and zinc, rinse and hydrate after every session, and book a cooling, repairing facial — such as the Cryo Skin Reset or the PDRN Cellular Repair — every 2–3 weeks.
- [Kobido vs Gua Sha: Which Face Massage Should You Choose?](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/kobido-vs-gua-sha/): Choose Kobido if you want a lifting, toning effect: it uses fast, rhythmic lifting motions and percussive tapping and is known as the "natural facelift". Choose Gua Sha if you want relaxation and gentle drainage: smooth stones glide over the face to release tension and depuff. For deep jaw tension, add a Buccal Massage.
- [Buccal Massage in Bali: What It Is, What to Expect & Results](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/buccal-massage-what-to-expect/): Buccal massage is an intra-oral facial massage: with gloved hands, the therapist works the jaw and cheek muscles from inside the mouth as well as outside, reaching deep muscles a regular face massage cannot. It releases jaw tension from clenching, drains puffiness and gives a more sculpted contour — with no needles or filler. At POINT · FACE it takes 15 minutes and can be added to any facial.
- [What Is a PDRN (Salmon DNA) Facial? Benefits, Results & Who It's For](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/what-is-pdrn-salmon-dna-facial/): PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) is a purified DNA fragment, usually extracted from salmon, used in Korean dermatology to support skin repair and regeneration. In a non-invasive PDRN facial it is applied topically in serums and masks and driven deeper with ultrasound — no needles — to calm redness, strengthen the skin barrier and help stressed skin recover.
- [Best Facial in Uluwatu: How to Choose the Right Facial Studio](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/best-facial-uluwatu-guide/): The best facial in Uluwatu is the one matched to your skin: look for a studio that starts with a skin analysis, offers both technology-led and natural facials, uses recognised skincare, publishes clear all-inclusive prices and has strong recent reviews. POINT · FACE has two studios — Uluwatu Ungasan and Uluwatu Bingin — specialised in Korean Hydrafacials, Balinese natural facials and sculpting face massages.
- [How Often Should You Get a Facial in Bali's Climate?](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/how-often-facial-bali-climate/): In Bali's hot, humid and sunny climate, most people benefit from a professional facial every 3–4 weeks — roughly one skin-renewal cycle. For a specific concern such as acne or pigmentation, a series of 3 sessions spaced 2–3 weeks apart works best, followed by maintenance every 4–8 weeks. If you are visiting, book one facial early in your trip and one before you fly home.
- [Why Does My Skin Get Dehydrated in Bali — and Which Facial Helps?](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/why-skin-gets-dehydrated-in-bali/): Skin gets dehydrated in Bali because of a chain of stressors: dry cabin air on the flight, strong UV, salt water, wind and nights in air-conditioning. They pull water from the outer layers and weaken the barrier. A hydrating facial that infuses humectants and repairs the barrier — such as a Korean Hydrafacial or a PDRN repair facial — restores comfort and glow in one session.
- [Korean Hydrafacial vs Hydrafacial vs Manual Facial: Which Is Best for You?](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/hydrafacial-vs-korean-facial/): A classic Hydrafacial is a device-led protocol: hydrodermabrasion to cleanse, extract and infuse serums. A Korean Hydrafacial uses the same technology but adds a multi-step Korean skincare ritual — layered K-beauty actives, masks and massage — for a hydrated "glass skin" finish. A manual facial uses hands and natural products only: more sensory and relaxing, with gentler, shorter-lived results. For visible glow and deep cleansing in Bali's climate, the Korean Hydrafacial gives the best of both.
- [What Is Glass Skin — and Can a Facial Give It to You?](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/what-is-glass-skin/): Glass skin is a Korean beauty term for skin so hydrated, smooth and clear that it looks translucent and reflects light like glass. It rests on three pillars: deep hydration, refined texture (clean pores, no build-up) and a healthy barrier. A Korean Hydrafacial delivers all three in one session — the glow is visible immediately and lasts about a week.
- [Pre-Wedding Facial Timeline for a Bali Wedding](https://www.pointfacebali.com/journal/pre-wedding-facial-timeline-bali/): For a wedding in Bali, start 2–3 months before with a series of targeted facials (acne, pigmentation or firmness), keep a monthly hydrating facial, then book your final glow facial 2–5 days before the ceremony — never the day before. In Uluwatu, our Caviar Luxury Anti-Aging & Lift or Ultimate Glass Skin plus a Buccal Massage give maximum lift and glow with no redness on the day.
